enrichment.headline: Gives final approval to the 2021-22 labor agreement with the Building & Construction Trades Council
enrichment.summary: The Board gives final approval to a tentative labor agreement between the district and the Buildings & Construction Trades Council of Alameda County for the 2021-22 fiscal year. The action text does not state a dollar amount; it refers to a public disclosure of the agreement's cost and a letter from the Alameda County Office of Education.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Agreement - Oakland Unified School District and the Building & Construction Trades Council of Alameda County - 2021-2022 Fiscal Year (Final Adoption)

enrichment.headline: Gives final approval to the labor agreement with the Oakland Education Association, teachers' union
enrichment.summary: The Board gives final approval to a tentative agreement, dated November 12, 2021, between the district and the Oakland Education Association, the union for Oakland teachers. The action text does not state a dollar amount; it refers to a public disclosure of the agreement's cost and a letter from the Alameda County Office of Education.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Agreement - Oakland Unified School District and the Oakland Education Association - As of November 12, 2021 (Final Adoption)

enrichment.headline: Gives final approval to a side letter with United Administrators of Oakland Schools
enrichment.summary: The Board gives final approval to a side letter dated December 1, 2021, which is an add-on to the existing labor contract between the district and the United Administrators of Oakland Schools, the union for school administrators. The action text does not state a dollar amount; it refers to a public disclosure of the agreement's cost and a letter from the Alameda County Office of Education.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Side Letter of Agreement - Oakland Unified School District and United Administrators of Oakland Schools - As of December 1, 2021 (Final Adoption)

enrichment.headline: Gives final approval to a side letter with Teamsters Locals 70 and 853
enrichment.summary: The Board gives final approval to a side letter dated January 20, 2022, which is an add-on to the labor contract between the district and Teamsters Locals 70 and 853. The action text does not state a dollar amount; it refers to a public disclosure of the agreement's cost and a letter from the Alameda County Office of Education.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Agreement (Side Letter of Agreement) - Oakland Unified School District and Teamsters Locals 70 and 853, As of January 20, 2022 (Final Adoption)

enrichment.headline: Gives final approval to the labor agreement with SEIU Local 1021 through September 2023
enrichment.summary: The Board gives final approval to a tentative labor agreement between the district and Service Employees International Union (SEIU) Local 1021, covering July 1, 2021 through September 30, 2023. The action text does not state a dollar amount; it refers to a public disclosure of the agreement's cost and a letter from the Alameda County Office of Education.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Agreement - Oakland Unified School District and Service Employees International Union, Local 1021 - July 1, 2021 - September 30, 2023 (Final Adoption)

enrichment.headline: Approves one-time payments and pay schedule changes for unrepresented and confidential staff
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts Resolution No. 2122-0224, which sets one-time payments outside the regular salary schedule and salary schedule adjustments effective July 1, 2022. It covers substitute and hourly employees who are not in a union, confidential employees, and employees with individual employment contracts. The action text does not state dollar amounts.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Compensation Increase - One Time Off Schedule Payments and Salary Schedule Adjustments - Unrepresented Substitue/Hourly Employees, Confidential Employees and Employees With Employment Contract
